lastCompletedStory.title: Surface failed abandon-path checkout-main to the operator

nextStoryContext: This was the only story in the PRD (single-story). makeInProgressConflictResolverDeps (src/commands/sidecar.ts) now takes (cwd, sessionName, realSpawnFn, logEvent) instead of just (cwd): its checkoutMainFn re-checks HEAD via readHeadBranchName + isCamFeatureBranch (both exported from src/supervisor/in-progress-conflict.ts) after the git checkout main attempt, logs a durable 'abandon-checkout-main-failed' WorkerEvent (new kind in src/supervisor/events.ts, detail: { stuckBranch }) and pushes a one-line notify via the existing makeNotifyOrchestrator seam ONLY on failure (non-zero exit OR HEAD still cam/*). All 4 steps (git call, HEAD re-check, log, notify) individually try/catch-wrapped -- never throws, since pollAndResolveGate (gate.ts) calls the resolver with no surrounding try/catch. No force/hard-reset/stash/clean added; the pure resolver contract in in-progress-conflict.ts (InProgressConflictResolverDeps.checkoutMainFn: () => void) is unchanged, only the production dep-builder signature grew. Test coverage lives in test/sidecar-gate-phase.test.ts's new describe block (real tmpdir git repo, dirty tracked-file conflict forces `git checkout main` to fail deterministically) -- driven via the already-exported buildGatePhaseDeps, not a new export.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed git checkout <branch> exits non-zero and leaves HEAD on the original branch when uncommitted local changes to a tracked file would be overwritten by the switch -- matches this story's detection logic (non-zero exit OR HEAD still resolves to the cam/* branch) and the real-git test's observed behavior.
